faqs.question: Is there a completely free alternative to Microsoft Visio?
faqs.answer: Yes. Draw.io (diagrams.net) is 100% free and open-source. Lucidchart has a free plan.

faqs.question: Which Visio alternative is best for cross-platform use?
faqs.answer: Draw.io is the best free alternative for cross-platform use — it's web-based and has desktop versions for Mac, Windows, Linux.

faqs.question: Can I open my Visio VSDX files in Draw.io?
faqs.answer: Draw.io supports importing VSDX files. Some complex diagrams may need adjustment.
